batch_node.name: qualys dimension vocabulary v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Dimension nodes for the key the qualys plugin stamps on the types it owns (specs/spec-qualys-v0.md, Default dimensions). Dimensions are declared, never created on demand.

node.name: qualys.area
node.description: Which part of Qualys a node or edge describes: run (subscriptions and scan runs), observation (hosts as Qualys tracks them), finding (detections), knowledge (knowledge-base QID records) or tagging (the subscription's asset tags). Stamped by every qualys node and edge type through DEFAULT_DIMENSIONS or default_dimensions. Not part of any natural key.
